name: Ransomware Outbreak
summary: Encryption-based extortion event impacting endpoints / file shares. Covers crypto-locker, double-extortion (data theft + encrypt), and ransomware-as-a-service variants.

steps.title: Confirm crisis-comms tree and ransomware advisor on call
steps.description: Verify IR lead, legal counsel, executive comms, and an external DFIR retainer are reachable. Pull the latest ransom-negotiation playbook from the legal vault.

steps.title: Verify backup immutability + offline restore path
steps.description: Confirm the last full restore test, that backups are immutable / air-gapped, and that the restore runbook has been exercised in the last 90 days.

steps.title: Scope encryption blast radius
steps.description: Identify affected hosts, shares, and cloud buckets. Capture extensions, ransom-note hash, drop locations. Pivot off process-creation telemetry and SMB/NFS write spikes.

steps.title: Identify ransomware family + TTPs
steps.description: Cross-check IOCs and ransom-note language against ID-Ransomware / NoMoreRansom + threat-intel feeds. Map known TTPs to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

steps.title: Network-isolate impacted hosts
steps.description: Quarantine affected endpoints at the EDR / NAC layer; block C2 IPs at the perimeter; disable inbound RDP and SMB to the affected VLAN.

steps.title: Rotate domain admin + service account credentials
steps.description: Force-rotate KRBTGT twice (24h apart) plus domain admin, backup service, and break-glass accounts. Invalidate active Kerberos tickets and OAuth refresh tokens.
evidence_hints: AD audit log of password resets

steps.title: Remove payload and persistence
steps.description: Re-image impacted endpoints; remove scheduled tasks / WMI subscriptions / startup keys; verify EDR shows no residual loader activity for 24h.

steps.title: Restore from immutable backup
steps.description: Restore impacted data from the last known-clean immutable backup. Validate file integrity hashes before re-attaching to production.

steps.title: Conduct after-action review
steps.description: Hold a blameless retro within 10 business days. Document timeline, dwell time, decisions, and gaps.

steps.title: File control-uplift tickets
steps.description: Translate each identified gap into a tracked engineering ticket with an owner and a 30/60/90 deadline. Link tickets back to this incident.
